create_gaudi_euler_scheduler: create a GaudiEulerDiscreteScheduler instance with custom beta schedule and prediction type for HPU-optimized diffusion
reset_timestep_dependent_params: reset the timestep-dependent sigma parameters in a GaudiEulerDiscreteScheduler to clear cached sigma lists
get_params_sigma: get the current sigma and next sigma values from a GaudiEulerDiscreteScheduler for the active step index
roll_params_sigma: roll the sigma parameter tensors forward by one step in a GaudiEulerDiscreteScheduler to advance timesteps
step_denoise_sample: step a GaudiEulerDiscreteScheduler to predict the denoised sample from model output and current timestep
